ICS 59.080.30TXD 33Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This standard prescribes construction all details and other particulars of 6 varieties of nylon fabric, undyed ordered used for industrial and special purposes1.2 This standard does not specify the general appearance, feel, etc. of the fabric (see 4.5).2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
